commit.message:
Integrate node with crawler over NATS via shared stream binding

Make the node the crawl-order producer and ingest consumer: an operator
posts seeds to /crawl on the ops mux, the node publishes a CrawlOrder, and
incoming IngestBatch messages route into the URL and posting receivers with
per-batch Ack/Nak honoring backpressure. The NATS edge is confined to
crawlbroker and stays optional behind NATS_URL.

Lift the JetStream stream binding into yacycrawlcontract so both sides share
one source of truth. Relocate the node Dockerfile under yacynode, add a
crawler Dockerfile, and turn docker-compose.yml into an example with nats and
crawler services.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Extract node implementation into yacynode gowork module

Move the node implementation (internal slices, cmd binaries, e2e suite, and
docs) out of the tooling root module into a dedicated yacynode module so the
node's runtime dependency graph is isolated from the workspace's lint/build
tooling. Rewrite internal import paths, repoint .go-arch-lint.yml components,
the Makefile module loop and targets, the Dockerfile build path, and the e2e
module's relative replace paths. The e2e suite stays a separate GOWORK=off
module, so its docker/testcontainers dependencies remain confined to its own
go.mod and never enter the node binary.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
